description: NaSi crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to seven Si atoms. There are a spread of Na-Si bond distances ranging from 3.09-3.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six Si atoms. There are a spread of Na-Si bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to six Na and three Si atoms. There are a spread of Si-Si bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.45 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to seven Na and three Si atoms. The Si-Si bond length is 2.57 Å.
